skills: Up to 3 Ether hits. Hold during the 3rd to charge: pulls enemies in and widens the hit. After other skills, hold to go straight to the 3rd hit.
In Idyllic Cadenza, press: a Tremolo shot for Ether DMG. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
In Idyllic Cadenza, press during a Perfect Dodge: several Tremolos for massive Ether DMG. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.
In Idyllic Cadenza, hold: a Tremolo that ends the state and grants her Core Passive buff. With enough Energy, spends it on 1 more Tremolo (counts as EX Special) and 3 Tone Clusters.
Ether attack ahead; you can steer while using it.
Dodges the incoming attack and triggers Vital View.
Backsteps, fires a Tremolo and enters Idyllic Cadenza. Hold to pull enemies in and add 1–4 Tremolos. Triggers a Quick Assist on hit.

Her stance: the whole squad gets bonus DMG and CRIT DMG (scales with skill level). She can't move, takes 40% less DMG, and stays on the field invulnerable when you switch out; switching back follows up with Windchimes & Oaths. Hold to leave with Finale, or to leave directly.

Every 25 Energy is 1 Chord. With a Chord in Cadenza, the on-field Agent's hits trigger her Quick Assist (once per 3s, or 1s for heavy hits). When a squadmate swaps in by Quick Assist, Chain, Defensive or Evasive Assist, she spends 25 Energy for a Tremolo (counts as EX Special). Tapping the Quick Assist fast gives a Precise Assist: 3 Tone Clusters follow (automatic for Chain and Assist swaps).
Sung energy blast for massive Ether DMG, then enters Idyllic Cadenza.
Sung energy blast for massive Ether DMG and heals the squad, then enters Idyllic Cadenza. Her next two Quick Assists become Chain Attacks.

core.name: Graceful Andante
core.text: In Idyllic Cadenza, when a squadmate swaps in by Quick Assist, Chain, Defensive or Evasive Assist, or when she spends Energy on a Tremolo, she and the incoming Agent gain ATK equal to {0}% of her initial ATK (max 1,200) for 20s, extendable to 30s.

ability.name: Moonlit Frenzy
ability.text: When she spends Energy on a Precise Assist or Finale, she adds 1 more Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters.

mindscapes: Her hits lower enemy All-Attribute RES by 6% (3 stacks, 30s). Enters battle with 1,000 Decibels. Ultimate gives the squad 1 Song of Protection for 60s: 1s of invulnerability when hit.
Core Passive ATK buff +19% (max +400). In Cadenza, a squadmate swapping in by Quick Assist, Chain, Defensive or Evasive Assist adds 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters (once per 3s).

For 15s after a Chain or Ultimate she can Quick Assist without Chords, and her hits allow it every 1s. In Cadenza, a squadmate who swaps in by Quick Assist gets a buff by specialty (once per 3s squad-wide): Attack, an extra hit for 300% of her ATK; Anomaly, +50% Anomaly Buildup; Stun, +50% Daze.
In Cadenza, Tremolos and Tone Clusters deal 200% of their normal DMG with +80% CRIT Rate. A Precise Assist also adds a charged Capriccio 3rd hit with +80% CRIT Rate (once per 10s).
